title: Veil-rays at Hamal Crystal Bloom; verdigris curd sold at Central Nexus
note: Seven kills in 33 minutes with a Pulse Laser I (2026-11-15). A carcass holds 1 or 2 curd. Curd bids: 330 cr. The first measured run is too high: its 9 curd included carcasses an earlier, unrecorded hunt had left here. The clean run at GSC-0027 gave about 4,200 cr per ship-hour. The herd read 0 at 17:17 UTC after our hunts. Ranched from 2026-11-15 17:40 UTC: no hunt below four animals and four kills a run, until data/wildlife/history.jsonl shows how fast the herd regrows. Sold at Central Nexus from 2026-11-15 21:40 UTC: Node Beta's curd bid was down to 15 units (data/market, 20:45 UTC), Central Nexus bid 330 for 50.
